## [1.30.1](https://github.com/dhrubonai/morphe-patches/releases/tag/v1.30.1) (2026-10-14)

### Bug Fixes

* Complete streaming + download fix. Includes all 4 fixes from Oct 14. **Users must re-patch their MovieBox APK** — updating the bundle alone is not enough, the fix is baked into the APK at patch time.
